html: † שׁוּחַ n.pr.m. son of Abr. and Ḳeturah, Gn 25:2 1 Ch 1:32; Σωυε, Σωε, Σουε.—In Assyrian Šuḫi is named as Aramaean land on Euphr. (left bank Tiele Gesch. 153 < right bank, cf. especially Schr KG 142 f.; it had, however, dependencies on left bank) by TP I. (KB i. 33), Ašurnaṣirp. (id. ib. 99, 101).
